message.content: In the discussion, Viper mentioned noticing an increase in their stamina during workouts and expressed satisfaction with how it felt to push harder and not get as tired as before. However, regarding specific plans to increase stamina, no direct action was suggested by Viper. Instead, Viper shared that they found interval training particularly effective in building endurance without overworking their bodies. Viper recommended incorporating interval training into cardio routines, suggesting starting with shorter intervals and gradually increasing the intensity and duration as one becomes more comfortable. This approach seems to be Viper's strategy for enhancing stamina, although it was not explicitly stated as part of their own plan to increase stamina.
